Pay: Ranging from $18.75 - 23.75/hr + Overtime + Full Benefits 

Who we are

CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery - our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality, and convenient for everyone. 

We take underutilized properties and transform them into smart kitchens so they can better serve restaurateurs, customers, and the neighborhoods they’re in. Every time we launch a new facility, we create jobs in that neighborhood, and we’re proud to provide a wide range of cuisines and options for healthy food at an affordable price.

We're changing the game for restaurateurs, whether they’re entrepreneurs opening their first restaurant, all the way through to your favorite global quick-service restaurant chains.

 

Why this role is different

This isn’t a typical handyman job bouncing between unrelated work orders.

  • Work on modern, standardized commercial kitchen facilities
  • Consistent environments → faster repairs, less guesswork
  • Mix of hands-on repairs + preventative maintenance + facility support
  • Independent work with support from experienced teams when needed
  • Clear path to grow into Senior Technician or Facilities Management roles

jobs.title: Market Manager
jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

At Picnic, we’re reinventing the way employees experience lunch at work. By partnering with top local restaurants and batching hundreds of orders, we make it easy for companies to offer high-quality, individually packed meals, without fees or tips. Our mission is to create a seamless, affordable, and joyful lunch experience that benefits both employees and employers.

 

About the role

As a Market Manager, your job is to get Picnic in front of the right people and turn those relationships into customers, referrals, and repeatable growth channels. Your efforts will make Picnic ubiquitous among office managers and workplace communities. You'll own the full cycle of promotion, outreach, relationship-building, and deal-closing, all the way to ongoing account health that turns customers into referral sources.

 

What you'll do 

  • Top-line growth. Revenue is the primary metric. You decide where growth comes from: new logos, expansion within existing accounts, participation rate, order frequency. You build the plan and hit the number.
  • Market strategy. Which submarkets, offices, and verticals to prioritize, and in what sequence. Your city has thousands of target offices. The work is identifying which of them matter most as we scale.
  • Local engagement. Referrals from existing accounts

jobs.location_raw: Chicago, IL · New York, NY · Austin, TX
jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

At Picnic, we’re reinventing the way employees experience lunch at work. By partnering with top local restaurants and batching hundreds of orders, we make it easy for companies to offer high-quality, individually packed meals, without fees or tips. Our mission is to create a seamless, affordable, and joyful lunch experience that benefits both employees and employers.

 

About the role

As a Restaurant Operations Manager, you’ll own restaurant supply for the XYZ region: find the right restaurants, sign the partner, and make sure they deliver: enough capacity, prepped on time, packaged properly, with menus and photos worth ordering from. That means real ownership and real accountability from day one. You’ll spend time in facilities and restaurants, tasting food and talking to operators.

 

What you’ll do

  • Selection. Selection depth and cuisine coverage are a key KPI. You decide where it comes from: brick-and-mortar partners, standalone restaurants, and CK facility operators (with CK sales). You make sure every hub has real options at the different price tiers.
  • Restaurant performance. Signing, onboarding, launch, and ongoing health. You own the capacity model, drive on-time prep, and make the pause and unpause calls. If a partner’s prep-by times slip in month three, that’s yours to diagnose and fix.

jobs.title: Technical Content Writer
jobs.location_raw: San Fransisco, Bay Area OR Pittsburgh, PA OR Austin, TX
jobs.description_text:
Efficient Computer is rethinking computing from the ground up to solve one of AI's biggest challenges: energy. Our Fabric architecture delivers a 10–100x improvement in energy efficiency for general-purpose computation, including AI, while supporting familiar programming languages and software frameworks—unlocking new possibilities for autonomous machines, intelligent infrastructure, wearables, and space systems. With our first processor, Electron E1, now shipping in volume and more than $97 million in Series B financing recently announced, we're accelerating customer deployments and scaling our architecture to data center performance. Join us to build the hardware and software that bring intelligence wherever it's needed and help shape the next generation of computing.

Efficient Computer is seeking a Technical Content Writer who enjoys figuring out how things work and helping other people understand them. You have an engineering background, and writing is the part of the job you want to spend more time doing.
